s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin lesions with systemic symptoms and abnormal laboratory results
salient_findings: Numerous erythematous papules and nodules on the abdomen and lower back
Leukopenia, anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia
Elevated C-reactive protein and alkaline phosphatase
key_facts: Skin lesions on abdomen and lower back
No weight loss, chills, abdominal pain, bleeding, or healing problems
Negative panel for sexually transmitted infections
Shave biopsy showed dense infiltrate of monotonous neoplastic cells

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Skin lesions with systemic symptoms and abnormal laboratory results

shortlist.label: Leukemia cutis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin lesions with leukopenia, anemia, and thrombocytopenia

shortlist.label: Mantle cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Skin lesions with systemic symptoms and lymphoma in differential diagnosis

shortlist.label: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Skin lesions with leukopenia and abnormal laboratory results

shortlist.label: Myeloid sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Skin lesions with systemic symptoms and abnormal laboratory results, including elevated alkaline phosphatase

raw.rationale: The presence of skin lesions with a dense infiltrate of monotonous neoplastic cells, along with leukopenia, anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia, is consistent with Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, a rare and aggressive hematological malignancy that often presents with skin involvement and bone marrow failure.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While it can cause skin lesions, the biopsy description and laboratory findings do not specifically support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Leukemia cutis
rejected.why: The biopsy findings do not clearly indicate a leukemia diagnosis, and the clinical presentation is not typical for leukemia cutis

rejected.label: Mantle cell lymphoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis typically involves lymph nodes and other organs, and the biopsy description does not specifically support mantle cell lymphoma

rejected.label: Myeloid sarcoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings do not specifically support myeloid sarcoma, which typically involves a myeloid leukemia
